description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Migrate application storage usage from AWS S3 to Azure Blob Storage.
tasks.reason: The project currently uses AWS S3 and needs Azure-native object storage for modernization.
tasks.requirements: Migrate S3-based storage operations in impacted modules to Azure Blob Storage while preserving current upload, download, list, and delete behavior. Use managed identity authentication for Azure access.

tasks.description: Migrate message processing from RabbitMQ to Azure Service Bus.
tasks.reason: The project currently uses RabbitMQ and must align messaging with Azure-managed services.
tasks.requirements: Migrate RabbitMQ-based message producer and consumer flows in web and worker modules to Azure Service Bus and preserve functional message flow semantics. Use managed identity authentication for Azure access.

tasks.description: Migrate PostgreSQL authentication to Azure managed identity.
tasks.reason: The project uses password-based PostgreSQL access and needs passwordless Azure authentication.
tasks.requirements: Update PostgreSQL connection authentication from password-based access to managed identity for Azure Database for PostgreSQL while preserving existing data access behavior.

tasks.description: Scan project dependencies for CVEs and remediate vulnerabilities.
tasks.reason: Security validation is required in every modernization plan before deployment activities.
tasks.requirements: Scan all project dependencies for known CVEs and remediate identified vulnerabilities. Upgrade vulnerable dependencies to patched versions and verify the project builds and tests pass after remediation.
